# Assessment Facts Overview

This directory contains supplementary architecture and analysis artifacts generated during assessment.

- [architecture-diagram.md](./architecture-diagram.md): High-level and component-level architecture diagrams.
- [dependency-map.md](./dependency-map.md): Build/runtime dependency relationships.
- [api-service-contracts.md](./api-service-contracts.md): External API contracts and internal service communication flow.
- [data-architecture.md](./data-architecture.md): Data model and persistence architecture summary.
- [configuration-inventory.md](./configuration-inventory.md): Configuration keys, sources, and runtime settings.
- [business-workflows.md](./business-workflows.md): Core business workflows and sequence diagrams.
